items.title: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO
items.summary: Anthropic在IPO前夕告知投资者其第三季度营收达到168亿美元，环比增长近50%，且调整后运营利润率达到11%。公司针对竞争对手的模型蒸馏行为进行了重大管控，该业务在第二季度曾贡献超5亿美元收入，但第三季度占比已降至营收的5%至7%。
items.summary_en: Anthropic reported Q3 revenue of $16.8bn, a nearly 50% increase from Q2, with an 11% adjusted operating margin and $1.70 in revenue for every $1 spent on computing power. The company materially reduced "distillation"—where rivals train models on Anthropic's outputs—which accounted for 5-7% of revenue, equating to over $500mn in distillation spending by other labs in Q2 alone.

items.title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
items.summary: AI卡路里追踪应用Cal AI在创始人Zach Yadegari年仅19岁时成立后两年内实现超3000万美元收入，并于今年3月被MyFitnessPal收购，其核心增长策略是签约大量KOL以固定付费置换获客量的线性模型，要求网红持续发帖直至达成特定新增用户数。创始人随后推出了已融资1000万美元的AI代理初创公司Persona，旨在打造可接入iMessage、电话等全渠道的个人AI助手及硬件生态。
items.summary_en: Cal AI, founded in 2024 by 19-year-old Zach Yadegari, generated over $30 million in revenue within two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal in March, largely due to a scalable influencer strategy that treated user acquisition as a linear conversion metric. Key to the method was negotiating performance-based payouts with influencers possessing tight communities to ensure specific viewer-to-user conversion rates. Yadegari has since launched a new AI agent startup, Persona, which raised $10 million to develop a cross-platform personal assistant supported by a dedicated hardware ecosystem.

items.title: NVIDIA 发布开源 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 及 Bolt 两款端侧模型
items.summary: NVIDIA 发布 1200 亿参数的开源多模态模型 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，其任务完成速度比同类次优模型快 5 倍，并附带开放权重与训练配方，已在 Hugging Face 等平台上线；同时推出两款端侧模型 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB 和 Bolt E4B 4GB（后者于 10 月 23 日上线），采用原生 2-bit 量化技术，支持在 RTX 或 DGX Spark 等本地硬件上高效运行智能体工作负载。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA released the open-source Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120-billion-parameter multimodal model that is 5x faster than the next-best competitor while matching the accuracy of its largest reasoning models, supported by post-training initiatives from over 30 organizations including Scale AI and Perplexity. The release also includes two edge-optimized variants: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B (24GB) for local agent workloads and Bolt E4B (4GB) for rapid conversational agents, both utilizing native 2-bit quantization to run locally on RTX and DGX Spark hardware.

items.title: [AINews] Modal’s $1B ARR, $16B Series D makes it NYC’s newest AI Infra Decacorn, 3x usage and 3x valuation in 5 months, 15x in 1 yr
items.summary: Modal 完成 160 亿美元 D 轮融资，估值在 5 个月内翻 3 倍至 100 亿美元，其核心 Sandboxes 产品年化收入达 3 亿美元，已支持 30 亿次沙箱调用并具备百万级并发能力，主要应用于 AI 代码生成、强化学习及智能体基础设施。
items.summary_en: Modal has crossed $1B in annual recurring revenue and secured a $16B Series D valuation, achieving a 15x valuation increase within one year. The company's Sandboxes product, launched in 2023 to support LLM code generation, now represents a $300M run-rate business that has executed nearly 3 billion sandboxes with support for up to 1 million concurrent instances. This infrastructure scale powers use cases including background agents, reinforcement learning, and vibecoding platforms, enabling users to securely launch RDMA clusters for distributed training and elastically manage state-of-the-art inference speculators.

items.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
items.summary: Meta 发布名为 Muse Spark Open 的开放权重模型，该模型具备 8160 亿参数和 100 万 token 上下文窗口，原生支持多模态及复杂编码任务。尽管本地运行需至少 1 TB RAM 且最佳适配配备 M5 Ultra 芯片的 Mac Studio，但 Meta 已将其与 Muse Code 搭配应用于 Mastodon 客户端开发及 DaVinci Resolve 视频剪辑等智能体工作流，并通过多个 API 平台提供访问服务。
items.why_now: Meta周四发布816B参数开源模型，现已上线API，Mac本地部署窗口已开启。
items.why_now_en: Meta's open-weight Mac model is available now, unlocking immediate local API access.
items.summary_en: Meta has launched Muse Spark Open, a natively multimodal open-weight model featuring 816 billion parameters and a 1 million token context window, designed to outperform rival open models in complex coding and agentic tasks. The model is optimized for local execution on Apple hardware, requiring a minimum of 1 terabyte of RAM and running best on the Mac Studio with the M5 Ultra chip. Meta has demonstrated its practical utility by deploying it with its Muse Code terminal to execute full build processes for a Mastodon client and operate DaVinci Resolve for automated video editing.

items.title: Meta 发布开源权重模型 Muse Spark Open，816B 参数、1M 上下文
items.summary: Meta 发布 816B 参数、42B 激活参数及 1M 上下文窗口的开源权重模型 Muse Spark Open，原生支持多模态输入并针对编码与智能体工作流优化，相比前代增加了安全后训练以抵御滥用。该模型在 SGLang 和 vLLM 上运行，通过 PyTorch 原生的 Helion 内核在 NVIDIA GB300 和 AMD MI350 上实现 1.03 至 3.95 倍的加速，并支持利用 TorchTitan 进行监督微调与强化学习以提升定制化能力。
items.why_now: Meta 今日开放 816B 权重模型，1M 上下文且免费部署，独立开发者可立即低成本构建高端编码智能体。
items.why_now_en: Strongest US open-weights model available now.

items.title: mksglu/context-mode
items.summary: Context Mode是一款支持17个平台的MCP服务器，通过沙箱工具将原始数据隔离在上下文窗口外，实现315 KB至5.4 KB的98%体积压缩，并利用SQLite与FTS5索引在会话压缩后通过BM25搜索精准恢复会话状态。其核心范式要求LLM编写脚本执行数据分析（如以1次ctx_execute调用替代47次文件读取），节省100倍上下文空间，同时通过Claude Code等平台的Hook机制自动强制路由规则。
items.why_now: 刚发布：支持17平台的MCP插件可98%压缩上下文，且已集成OpenClaw网关，AI编码工具链进入“上下文即成本”优化窗口。
items.why_now_en: Mandatory "Think in Code" paradigm hits 17 clients today.
items.summary_en: Context Mode is an MCP server that optimizes AI coding agent context windows by sandboxing tool outputs for a 98% reduction, such as compressing 315 KB of data to 5.4 KB, while persisting session memory in SQLite with FTS5 and BM25 search to prevent data loss during conversation compaction. The system enforces a "Think in Code" paradigm across 17 platforms, including Claude Code, where agents generate scripts to perform data analysis rather than ingesting raw files, reducing context consumption by up to 100x through specific sandbox tools like ctx_execute and automated routing hooks.

items.title: Show HN: Eve Python Agent Template
items.summary: Eve Python Agent Template 基于 Eve、Next.js 和 FastAPI 构建了一个 Web 聊天代理，通过 Vercel 部署，支持代理调用 Python 工具管理共享任务列表并执行数据统计。该模板采用单一任务列表模式，通过 `EVE_CHAT_PASSWORD` 进行简易身份验证，并利用 Vercel AI Gateway 处理模型调用，开发者可通过 `pnpm dev:all` 在本地联调 Web 前端、代理及后端服务。
items.why_now_en: Vercel now unifies Python FastAPI agents and Next.js apps in one deploy
items.summary_en: Eve Python Agent Template is a full-stack web chat application built on Vercel that combines Next.js, a Python FastAPI backend, and an Eve agent to manage shared task lists and execute Python tools. It supports local development via Node.js 24 and pnpm, with the backend defaulting to SQLite storage if no database URL is provided, and requires setting the EVE_CHAT_PASSWORD environment variable for access control. The project structure consolidates the agent in the agent/ directory, the web interface in apps/web/, and the API in apps/api/, deploying as a single Vercel project.

items.title: DeepSeek 出现服务故障，官方补偿 1 周 Token 消耗；库克：苹果智能月底在华发测试版；特斯拉、SpaceX 最快年底合并｜极客早知道
items.why_now: 库克确认苹果智能月底在华发测试版，阿里千问模型同步接入。
items.why_now_en: Apple Intelligence tests launch in China this month

items.title: Surface Laptop Ultra 首发体验：是最强 Windows 笔记本，也是 AI 时代的全能本
items.why_now: 10月16日Surface Laptop Ultra上市，128GB内存让本地跑大模型不再受显存限制，开启端侧AI普惠窗口。
items.summary_en: Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X chip powers the Surface Laptop Ultra, featuring a 20-core Grace CPU, Blackwell GPU with 6,144 CUDA cores, and up to 128GB unified memory, delivering 1 PFLOPS of AI compute. This unified memory architecture allows local execution of large open-source models like Qwen3.5 35B at 59.65 tokens per second, enabling offline AI agent workflows and running complex Unreal Engine 5 projects without cloud dependency.

items.title: Jev meets the Trolley Problem
items.why_now: Jev等决策模型刚发布，以百倍速比LLM便宜，为开发者提供低成本决策新窗口。
items.why_now_en: Jev and Luna APIs are now live for decision tasks.
items.summary_en: The article evaluates "decision models"—fast, cheap alternatives to LLMs like Claude that output probabilistic choices rather than text—on the Trolley Problem, comparing OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna, Jev, and eleven local models across 5,240 test setups. While most models, including Jev, align with the 81% of human survey respondents from Awad et al. (2020) who support diverting a train to save five lives at the cost of one, the analysis highlights that model choices depend significantly on specific prompt wording.

items.title: Neural networks are clean
items.why_now: 文章未包含API发布、降价、关服或新政策等明确时效性信号，仅阐述可解释性研究的长期方法论结论。
items.why_now_en: Study nets directly: polysemanticity was a misread.
items.summary_en: The author argues that neural networks are inherently "clean" and that the canonical evidence for polysemanticity and superposition was a misinterpretation of "recursive generalization." Instead of requiring external decomposition like sparse autoencoders, modern architectures have achieved 99–100% interpretability in the final layers of models like InceptionV1 without changing model size or data. This allows researchers to study network mechanisms directly through rapid normal science, as neurons at various scales simply cover coarser or finer-grained concepts rather than folding unrelated functions together.

items.title: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 系列登陆 OpenRouter：Image Klein 开源权重、视频 upscale 降价并支持 4K 生成
items.why_now: FLUX Video Upscale 今日降价近半并支持4K，立即降低一人公司视频生成成本。
items.why_now_en: FLUX Video Upscale price drops 53% to $0.28/s today.
items.summary_en: Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3 Image Klein on OpenRouter, an open-weight image model capable of running on a single consumer GPU. The improved FLUX Video Upscale entered early access with a price drop from $0.59/s to $0.28/s for 4K conversion, while FLUX 3 Video now supports direct 4K video generation from text prompts.

items.title: Microsoft AI 公布 MAI-Base-2 预训练细节，2.8T 参数 MoE 模型 FLOPs 效率达 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base 的 4.2 至 12.3 倍
items.summary_en: Microsoft AI completed pre-training for MAI-Base-2, a Mixture-of-Experts model with 80 billion active and 2.8 trillion total parameters, which achieved bits-per-byte (BPB) scores lower than all tested open-weight models. The model demonstrated 4.2 to 12.3 times higher FLOPs efficiency compared to DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base, leveraging a robust scaling ladder, source scaling, and joint learning rate/weight decay hyperparameter optimization laws to achieve this performance advantage.

items.title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
items.summary: CLI-Anything 是 HKUDS 推出的开源框架，旨在通过生成统一的命令行界面（CLI）实现“任何软件 Agent-Native 化”，使 Pi、OpenClaw、Claude Code 等 AI Agent 能够直接调用 CAD、3D 场景、字幕制作等复杂软件并生成真实产物。该项目依托 CLI-Hub（安装命令为 pip install cli-anything-hub）提供社区共建的 CLI 注册中心，已整合 Obsidian、Joplin、Rekordbox、Calibre 等 20+ 类软件，并通过 defusedxml 等机制增强安全性与稳定性。
items.why_now: 2026年5月底CLI-Hub快速合并多场景CLI，抢占Agent标准化接入软件生态窗口。
items.why_now_en: Active CLIs now enable agents to control CAD, Unreal, and audio tools.

items.title: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
items.summary: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills 是一个包含 177 个经过验证的科学技能和 100 多个数据库的开源库，支持生物学、化学、医学及药物发现等跨学科领域，目前已被全球超过 250,000 名科学家使用。该库遵循开放 Agent Skills 标准，兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、Pi 及 Google Antigravity 等多种 AI 代理工具，并推出了名为 K-Dense BYOK 的免费桌面端 AI 共科学家，允许用户自带 API 密钥在本地运行 40 多种模型。
items.why_now: 发布免费本地化开源K-Dense BYOK，支持BYOK，降低AI科研门槛。
items.why_now_en: Now works with any agent via open Agent Skills standard, not just Claude.

items.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
items.summary: Anthropic向非营利组织METR的六名研究员提供员工级访问权限，包括公司笔记本电脑、办公空间及内部工具，以独立评估其模型安全与风险管理。这一举措落实了CEO Dario Amodei关于嵌入外部评估者以延缓技术发展的承诺，并构建了包含METR在内的三级评估体系，其中METR作为最高层级，Anthropic承诺不否决其公开发表风险评估结果，仅允许对敏感信息（如客户数据、法律特权信息）进行有限删减。
items.why_now: METR周四获员工级访问权，落实9月白宫独立审查协议，开创监管先例。
items.why_now_en: The White House accord and weekly agent incidents have just forced the first in-lab evaluator access.

items.title: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
items.why_now: Google 周四在美国上线 Universal Cart，开放 UCP 结账协议，AI 购物代理生态窗口已开启。
items.why_now_en: Google's U.S. Universal Cart launch opens a new agentic checkout window for indie merchants.

items.title: Perplexity 开源驱动 Perplexity Computer 的沙箱平台 SPACE
items.summary_en: Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas open-sourced SPACE, a sandbox platform powering Perplexity Computer, available at the "perplexityai/space" GitHub repository. While acknowledging sandboxing as a commodity, the release emphasizes that production-grade scaling for enterprise and consumer agents requires serving millions of sandboxes with significant engineering detail, thereby enabling developers to build their own agent infrastructure.

items.title: I built a Chrome extension that teaches you a language inside the pages you already read
items.summary: 开发者Ok_Professor2873基于FSRS间隔重复算法构建了Chrome扩展程序TALIRI，通过在日常浏览中将高频词汇（每语言约2000个）原位替换并高亮，实现无感语言学习，目前支持瑞典语、德语、印地语、西班牙语和法语。该工具采用本地化隐私保护机制，定价为7美元/月或49美元/年，其开发过程由Claude协调设计规格与UI审计、Codex负责后端逻辑实现，累计完成1100+次代码提交及250+项浏览器测试。

items.title: Prompt tips from Anthropic
items.summary: Google 发布新模型 Gemini 4 Argon，但实测显示其设计能力缓慢且效果不佳；Grok Voice 3.0 登顶语音转语音排行榜，目前日均处理约 2 万次 Starlink 客服通话。在效率工具方面，Keshav 提出一种复用方法，让智能体读取 chat-index.md 和 folder-map.md 文件来继续特定项目，而非重新开启会话；数据显示为编码智能体提供文档链接可将任务完成率从 41% 提升至 84%。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's Claude Code desktop app received a major upgrade featuring multi-folder environments, child sessions, and a proprietary version control system to replace git. The release coincides with reports that providing coding agents with documentation links doubles task completion rates from 41% to 84%, highlighting a critical workflow optimization for AI-assisted development.

items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
items.summary: VoiceStudio是一款支持646种语言的开源本地化语音处理工具，作为ElevenLabs的替代品，提供语音克隆、视频配音、转录及有声书制作功能。其默认采用k2-fsa/OmniVoice引擎驱动，支持通过一行命令安装，并具备针对NVIDIA GPU（CUDA）和Apple Silicon（Metal）的硬件加速能力，在无独立显卡的机器上也可运行约5GB大小的CPU版本。
items.summary_en: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully local alternative to ElevenLabs that supports voice cloning, design, video dubbing, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. Powered by the default k2-fsa/OmniVoice engine, it operates on user hardware with CUDA acceleration for NVIDIA GPUs, Metal (MPS) for Apple Silicon, and CPU-only support requiring approximately 5 GB of disk space. The tool is installed via a one-command script on macOS and Linux or PowerShell on Windows, and can be integrated into coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor using a specific agent guide.

items.title: morluto/rea
items.summary: REA 是一款名为 rea-agents 的逆向工程 MCP 工具，支持通过 `npx rea-agents setup` 一键集成至 Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI Agent，利用本地 Hopper、Ghidra 或 IDA 引擎对原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron 应用及 .NET 组件进行静态与运行时行为分析。该工具能自动提取模块依赖、Electron 边界及功能实现逻辑，并提供详细证据链，用户可通过终端执行 `npx -y rea-agents@latest analyze-javascript-application` 命令直接解析目标应用，无需源码即可深度理解并复现特定功能。
items.summary_en: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) is an MCP-compatible tool enabling AI agents to inspect native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites to reverse-engineer features without source code. Installation is managed via `npx rea-agents setup`, which integrates with agents like Claude Code and Codex, while native analysis can utilize existing Hopper, Ghidra, or IDA installations to generate local results with evidence-backed conclusions.

items.title: vxcontrol/pentagi
items.summary: PentAGI 是由 VXControl 开发的开源自托管多智能体渗透测试系统，通过 Docker 沙箱隔离运行 nmap、Metasploit 及 sqlmap 等 20 多种专业安全工具，实现自主规划与执行复杂的渗透测试任务。该系统支持 10 多家云端 LLM 提供商及本地 Ollama/vLLM 模型，结合 PostgreSQL 存储与可选的 Neo4j 知识图谱追踪主机及服务关系，为企业用户和研究人员提供基于自有基础设施的自动化红队测试能力。
items.summary_en: PentAGI is an open-source, self-hosted multi-agent system for autonomous penetration testing that executes over 20 professional tools, including nmap, Metasploit, and sqlmap, within isolated Docker sandboxes. Developed by Dubai-based VXControl, the platform supports 10+ LLM providers such as OpenAI and Ollama, utilizes PostgreSQL with pgvector for long-term memory, and offers an optional Neo4j knowledge graph to track semantic relationships between hosts and findings.

items.title: I know why the mathematicians weep
7天几百元开一家店！用千问办公电商版，立省启动资金5万元
items.summary: 千问办公推出电商版，通过打通钉钉上下文及MCP连接器调用ERP等工具，提供趋势洞察、素材批量生成等四大功能，如助捌比特团队将日晒豆数据应用于配方调整使新品销量提升10倍，并助Sandy团队将秋冬素材准备周期从4个月缩短至15天。对于商家而言，利用该工具将开店周期从30天压缩至7天，调研与素材制作成本从数万元降至数百元Token费用，且支持当天测款以规避库存滞销风险。

items.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
items.summary: 亚马逊SVP Panos Panay在TechCrunch Disrupt上发布AI可穿戴设备Bee，包括腕带式设备和可磁吸在手机背面的信用卡大小设备，通过被动录音和实时处理生成待办事项与洞察。该设备采用隐私优先设计，不存储原始音频，而是实时处理后删除录音，并通过用户设备控制的加密转录文本来保护数据，旨在推动无需主动调用应用的环境计算未来。

items.title: Online ads weaponised to deliver ‘zero-click’ spyware, researchers say
items.summary: 多伦多大学 Citizen Lab 研究人员发现，以色列广告代理机构 Discover-Tech 通过其 Controlium 平台向全球数百万用户投放广告，利用零点击技术向包括卡塔尔半岛电视台在内的目标设备植入间谍软件，该软件能秘密提取消息、照片及邮件并激活麦克风。该攻击无需用户交互即可在数秒内完成，受害群体涵盖欧美政府机构、联合国及北约等非政府实体，且主要广告供应商多年未能检测或阻止这一大规模监控行为。
items.summary_en: Israeli agency Discover-Tech operates Controlium, a platform that mass-profiles millions of users to deliver zero-click spyware via benign advertisements, allowing third-party firms to compromise devices without user interaction. Researchers at the University of Toronto found this system has been exploited to target entities including Al Jazeera, the UN, and NATO since 2024, enabling the extraction of messages, emails, and audio data.
